body:
Commit 8c0b501. Responded to Linode support's email confirming outbound SMTP restrictions were lifted for the carepyre-email Linode (id 104390828, 45.79.143.216). Re-verified live rather than trusting the email: outbound TCP 25 to gmail-smtp-in.l.google.com now connects (was a timeout before); rDNS (mail.carepyre.org), SPF (v=spf1 mx ~all), and DMARC records were already correct from the original fix and needed no changes. Posted a confirmation reply on ticket #27380609 and closed it via the Linode API, confirmed status:closed on re-fetch. No code/config changes needed -- this was purely Linode's own restriction to lift. Outbound delivery to Gmail/Outlook should now work end to end; a real send-and-receive test from console.html's webmail is the one thing not exercised this pass.

⚓ ☃
title: Akamai/Linode SMTP port-25 restriction confirmed lifted; ticket #27380609 closed
